title: SorobanServer.get_ledger_entries drops the extXdr field, so the sponsor of a ledger entry cannot be read

target.versions_affected: 17.0.1 and main 7b5fb3b9 (executed on both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: LedgerEntryResult declares key, xdr, lastModifiedLedgerSeq and liveUntilLedgerSeq but not extXdr, and pydantic ignores undeclared fields, so SorobanServer.get_ledger_entries, SorobanServerAsync.get_ledger_entries and the helpers built on them return entries without their LedgerEntryExt and so without the sponsoringId (CAP-33). No value is decoded wrongly (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: the parsed get_ledger_entries result carries the entry's LedgerEntryExt when the server sends extXdr
entries.observed: No corpus entry drives the RPC client. By hand on 17.0.1 and main 7b5fb3b9 with a local HTTP server answering in the shape stellar-rpc builds for a sponsored account: the server sends key, xdr, extXdr and lastModifiedLedgerSeq; the parsed entry has key, xdr, last_modified_ledger and live_until_ledger only. The same against stellar-rpc 30 on a local standalone network for an account created inside a sponsoring block.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's script on 17.0.1 and main 7b5fb3b9, with a local HTTP server: the parsed entry's fields are key, xdr, last_modified_ledger and live_until_ledger; extXdr, which holds the sponsor GCATS5YO…, is dropped.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-rpc's getLedgerEntries returns extXdr, the base64 LedgerEntryExt of the entry, since v23.0.0; LedgerEntryExt v1 carries sponsoringId (CAP-33).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on 17.0.1 and main 7b5fb3b9 before filing on 2026-11-19: the parsed entry has no extension.

queries: StellarCN/py-stellar-base: every issue and pull request, open and closed, about getLedgerEntries or extXdr
StellarCN/py-stellar-base: the active branches and the CHANGELOG

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/StellarCN/py-stellar-base/issues/1278; this record restates the public issue.
